summaryZh: Gupta 研究组旨在减轻胃肠道癌症尤其结直肠癌的负担。研究分析大规模医疗和癌症登记数据，并用前瞻性随机试验评估提高服务不足人群筛查率的策略。
researchQuestions: 结直肠息肉切除后接受监测性结肠镜检查，是否降低结直肠癌发病率或死亡率？
methods: 医疗与癌症登记数据分析

evidence.quote: Our research group's central purpose is to reduce the burden of gastrointestinal cancers, including colorectal cancer, across all populations.
utilizing large-scale healthcare and cancer registry data
prospective randomized trials of strategies to increase colorectal cancer screening rates among underserved populations.

Current funded initiatives include a National Cancer Institute-funded R37 award supporting a large-scale case-cohort study to determine whether exposure to surveillance colonoscopy after colorectal polypectomy reduces colorectal cancer incidence or mortality (Gupta, PI)
